acquisition: Official author-supplied complete archive or its GEFCom2014-W_V2.zip; raw observations are not bundled.

columns.timestamp: Hourly valid timestamp; parsed and sorted before model training.
columns.feature_ws10: Euclidean norm of U10 and V10.
columns.feature_ws100: Euclidean norm of U100 and V100.
columns.feature_target_lag1: Previous available observation on the chronologically sorted retained issue timeline; the evaluated model entry point recomputes this column for both training and prediction.

split.label_rule: Exact physical lead; exclude training or calibration rows whose labels reach the next split.
split.feedback_rule: Observation available at the first issue strictly after the label timestamp.

scope_note: The portable forecaster/candidate command runs one stream. Full fold training, source fitting and selector orchestration are provided as evaluated source archives, whose historical cache/provenance requirements must be regenerated for a new installation.
